description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Zscaler is hiring a Software Development Engineer for its Data & APIs team. The role builds and operates large-scale data pipelines, real-time streaming systems, backend services, and APIs that process and expose security telemetry.
Software Development Engineer building security-data backend services and APIs, contributing to streaming pipelines and telemetry anomaly detection.

Responsibilities:
• Build and maintain backend services and APIs (REST/gRPC) that expose Zscaler's security data to internal teams and customers, writing production-quality code across the request path
• Contribute to large-scale streaming and batch data pipelines (Kafka, Spark/Flink) and the storage layer (SQL, NoSQL, columnar) that feed those APIs — writing processing logic, tuning performance, and helping triangulate bottlenecks in production
• Participate in design discussions, write and review design docs for features you own, and contribute to AI/ML enabled anomaly-detection and signal-correlation logic over streaming telemetry
• Instrument, monitor, and operate the services you build — including on-call rotation, incident response, and continuous improvement of reliability and performance
• Spot pain points and friction in the existing system (bugs, slow queries, flaky tests, manual toil) and propose or ship improvements; partner with senior engineers, Product, and consuming teams to clarify requirements and deliver features — fluently using modern AI coding, review, and agentic tools across the SDLC

Requirements:
• Demonstrated fluency with the AI-augmented SDLC — daily, hands-on use of modern AI coding assistants, code-review tools, and agentic workflows — with a proven history of integrating new AI technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving
• 0-2 years of professional software engineering experience building backend services, with proficiency in at least one of Java, Python, or Go
• Hands-on experience designing and building APIs (REST and/or gRPC), including schema definition, versioning, and auth
• Working experience with streaming/batch data technologies (Kafka, Spark, Flink, Airflow, or equivalent) and relational and/or NoSQL databases, including basic performance analysis of pipelines (throughput, lag, resource utilization)
• Exposure to Azure and/or GCP (compute, managed data services, networking) and containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes), with basic observability and debugging skills
• Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems (consistency, partitioning, replication, fault tolerance, backpressure), with a clear track record of shipping production features end-to-end

Preferred:
• Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
• Experience with anomaly detection, signal triangulation, or correlation techniques over large-scale telemetry, logs, or security/networking data — statistical, rules-based, or ML
• Hands-on experience with Azure and/or GCP managed streaming and data services (Azure Event Hubs / Stream Analytics / Synapse / Cosmos DB; GCP Pub/Sub / Dataflow / BigQuery / Bigtable) and modern warehouse/lakehouse tech (Snowflake, Databricks, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch)
• Experience with API-first development practices — OpenAPI/protobuf, contract testing, and API lifecycle management
